items.title: Rodri undergoes back surgery amid speculation over his Man City future - Yahoo Sports
items.summary: # Rodri undergoes back surgery amid speculation over his Man City future. Manchester City midfielder Rodri has successfully undergone back surgery, the club has confirmed, though the exact duration of his absence remains unclear. The 30-year-old, who was crowned the 2024 Ballon d'Or winner, has been contending with a persistent back issue for some time, leading to what City described as a "minor" operation. The midfielder had been feeling discomfort for some time but has now undergone a procedure to address the issue and will now begin a short period of rehabilitation.". The former Atletico Madrid star, who has just one year remaining on his contract at the Etihad Stadium, has been linked with a potential move to Real Madrid, with rumours intensifying after he was named player of the tournament at the recent World Cup. New manager Enzo Maresca addressed the situation last week, stating he was "not worried" about the midfielder's future.

items.title: Chelsea Show Biggest Sign Yet of Move Into Another New Era - Sports Illustrated
items.summary: After the abomination that was the second half of the 2025–26 campaign, Chelsea’s ownership group made it clear things were about to change. For four years, the Blues had been laser-focused on signing young, high-potential players and building a squad that would be full to bursting with future superstars. ## Why Jordan Henderson Could Be Chelsea’s Signing of the Summer. This is not to say that the Chelsea dressing room is full of petulant teenagers, but there has been a noticeable drop in standards since the likes of N’Golo Kanté, César Azpilicueta and Thiago Silva were showing the world how it was done. He came off the bench for a total of six minutes during the 2026 World Cup, having been surprisingly called-up in the first place, and was not sent home even after a freak broken arm meant he could do nothing other than cheer on from the sidelines.
